question: What digital photos must an Express Entry applicant provide, and does the submitted document meet IRCC specifications?

claims.text: Digital photos meeting IRCC's permanent resident card photo specifications must be provided.
claims.quote: Digital photos meeting [IRCC’s permanent resident card photo specifications (PDF, 614.24 KB)](https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/migration/ircc/english/information/applications/guides/pdf/5445eb-e.pdf) must be provided.

basis: The applicant uploaded a 2-page digital photo document (case ID: 567864bdadffc58ba6391652a353fb8f) containing embedded image objects measuring 2562 x 3311 pixels on page 1 and 2590 x 3333 pixels on page 2.
